title: Railflash
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -8 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Original 128-second stereo drum and bass instrumental at fixed 172 BPM in 4/4. Loud complete groove begins on beat one: punchy two-step kick and snare, clean shuffled hats, deep but rounded rolling bass, bright chord accents and a clipped pitched synth attack on each quarter beat. Signature melody: four fast rising steps followed by a two-note low answer, with a new answering phrase in the second minute. Keep drums, bass and lead continuous and stable in every 8-second interval without a sparse bridge. Energetic, playful, family-friendly production rather than dark aggression. No intro, breakdown, fade, silence, tempo drift, clipping, vocals, speech, samples or imitation.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Two sharply angled parallel rails crossed by one coral flash, with small beat ticks; distinct from train, lightning bolt icon, keyboard or character. Original dark comic-print composition.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Horizontal duohertz card with crossed rails on right, Railflash title on left, dark editorial print and sparse halftone.
art_provenance.render_method: local macOS sips SVG-to-PNG; source raster equality checked before staging
art_provenance.cover_svg: Local SVG title overlay around the authored cover-art.png
